0.name: TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE1_00933_GEROLT_000_000
0.description: Time to take me demiatma-imbued tools and direct the isle's aether into somethin' truly majestic!

1.name: TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE1_00933_GEROLT_000_001
1.description: A sight o' the likes you've never seen before, eh? A shimmerin', shiftin', multi-layered mesh of aether made malleable, channeled with expert precision...

2.name: TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE1_00933_GEROLT_000_002
2.description: Behold the pinnacle o' weapon fabrication: <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203>!

3.name: TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE1_00933_GEROLT_000_003
3.description: Behold the pinnacle o' weapon an' shield fabrication: <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203> an' <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E803020203>!

4.name: TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE1_00933_GEROLT_000_004
4.description: To marvel at its glory is all well an' good, but the power within's naught but an illusory whisper─a fleetin' phantom, if ye will─until it's awoken in the throes o' battle.

5.name: TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE1_00933_GEROLT_000_005
5.description: All of which is to say, get out there an' wield the bleedin' thing!
